# Mercury Copilot Agent Infrastructure — Master Index

**Repository:** `um-dev-creative/mercury`
**Generated by:** Bootstrap Agent Infrastructure prompt
**Infrastructure version:** 1.0.0

---

## Overview

This directory contains the complete agent infrastructure for Mercury development:
automated, convention-enforcing agents that implement, review, test, and release
features across Mercury's multi-layer Spring Boot architecture.

---

## Quick Start

### Start a New Feature
```
Use prompt: .github/prompts/full-feature-delivery.prompt.md
Agent: orchestrator
Variables: featureName, featureDescription, layersAffected, securitySensitive
```

### Fix a Bug
```
Use prompt: .github/prompts/fix-bug.prompt.md
Agent: developer
Variables: bugDescription, affectedClass, reproducedBy
```

### Review a PR
```
Use prompt: .github/prompts/review-code.prompt.md
Agent: code-reviewer
Variables: prBranch, baseBranch
```

### Prepare a Release
```
Use prompt: .github/prompts/prepare-release.prompt.md
Agent: devops-engineer
Variables: releaseVersion, releaseSummary, releaseNotes
```

## Key Mercury Conventions

| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| OpenAPI annotations | `*Api` interfaces ONLY |
| DTOs | Java `record`s in `com.umdc.mercury.api.v1.to` |
| Logging | SLF4J `LoggerFactory.getLogger()` |
| Async writes | `CompletableFuture<T>` |
| Kafka topics | `${prx.consumer.topics.*}` |
| Scheduler rates | `${prx.scheduler.*}` |
| MapStruct | Spring beans, never `new *MapperImpl()` |
| Constructors | Explicit in every class (PMD) |
| Secrets | Vault-backed `${ENV_VAR}` |
| DDL | Flyway only, `ddl-auto: none` |
| Line coverage | ≥ 70% (JaCoCo gate) |
| Branch coverage | ≥ 50% (JaCoCo gate) |
| PMD violations | 0 (build gate) |

## Exception → HTTP Mapping

| Exception | HTTP |
|---|---|
| `CampaignNotFoundException` | 404 |
| `ForbiddenException` | 403 |
| `IllegalStateException` (channel disabled) | 422 |
| `IllegalArgumentException` (bad input) | 400 |
| `MethodArgumentNotValidException` | 400 |
